item.title: Silenced voices and new hopes: this author is seeking a Danish publisher for his collection of short stories written by Iranian teenagers
item.description: Thirty-five Iranian girls wrote short stories about their dreams of freedom under the Iranian regime. Jubin Mirzaee has compiled them and is about to publish them in a book. In an interview with the Copenhagen Post, he spoke about his own experiences of fleeing the authoritarian Iranian regime, living in a Danish asylum centre, and raising awareness of the repression faced by a generation of Iranians.
